summary: In the rain, drops ring the puddles and burst on roofs, decks and helmets, while walls under a roof stay dry. Lightning now strikes visibly on the horizon, lights the clouds and the field from its side, and its thunder arrives as late as the bolt is far.
rationale: Rings, splashes and lightning change over time, so the overview is an 18-second current-build clip moving from close puddles and a tank deck to a hut dry under its eaves and two visible strikes, with stills for paused inspection. A still of a two-storey house shows what a roof keeps dry (walls and gables) against its own wet covering. It is not a historical comparison: the soaked walls this follow-up removes never shipped. Thunder timing is documented and tested separately; this silent clip cannot demonstrate sound.

capture.provenance: Re-recorded after roofs began keeping the rain off what's under them and rivulets thinned: captioned frames for the clip, caption-free frames of the same run for the stills; the house still is a photo-mode capture (vignette and grain off, panel cropped away).
capture.stage_configuration: rain: seed 712, map seed 3, Forward+, 24 fps and 24 Hz fixed simulation; current-build labels and normal-speed playback.
capture.shots: Puddle at 0 s; tank deck at 4 s; hut wall dry under its eaves at 7.5 s; low camera at 10.5 s. Staged strikes at 11.4 s and 14.2 s. House: --scenario=storeys --seed=3 --mood=rain --static, photo pos 12.5:1.7:-15.5 yaw 40 pitch 10, 2100x900 cropped to 1600x900.
capture.limits: Close views make small surface effects visible. The soundtrack and thunder delay are not audible evidence in this asset; it does not compare an earlier revision.

source_ref: working tree after 86d03432 (rain cover under roofs, sparser rivulets)

sources.caption: Drops bursting on a tank's deck, the puddles round it ringed by the rain
